title: Rav Tachlifa bar Giza or Gaza
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He raises objections to Ravina in [Avodah Zarah 69a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.69a.2) and [Zevachim 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.39a.11).[^1]

notes.text: Avodah Zarah reads Rav Tachlifa bar Giza, and Zevachim reads Rav Tachlifa bar Gaza. Both write the title Rav in full. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3552&lang=en) cites both exchanges under the Gaza form.
